verdict.rationale: Windows is an operating system, so installing it on a machine is a fair question. The pack has no first-party installation docs. Community reports only show that Windows setup exists and that a user wiped a PC and reinstalled Windows on the same hardware, which is a glancing, indirect sign of a replace-in-place install. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of installing Windows over a different existing OS (e.g., replacing macOS or Linux), installation media and boot steps, hardware requirements, and data-migration guidance for switchers.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS in place of my current OS on the same machine

citations.quote: They wiped the PC and reinstalled with an offline account.
